mentions.name: Hourbun
mentions.description: Hourbun is an intuitive and fast time tracking and invoicing app for individuals and teams, enabling quick and reliable client invoicing without premium pricing or poor UI/UX.
mentions.problem: The author's previous invoicing app (Harvest) raised its price about 10x, leaving people and teams without a quick, reliable, affordable way to invoice clients.
mentions.audience: Harvest's ~10x price increase left the author without an affordable invoicing option; existing apps are priced high or suffer from bad UI/UX.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A while ago the invoicing app I used (Harvest) jacked up their price about 10x, so I decided to build one for myself.

And I did: https://hourbun.com/

Just an intuitive and fast time tracking and invoicing app built for people and teams like me who want a quick and reliable way of invoicing clients without paying a premium or suffer through bad UI/UX.
